bayts.text: You have shown me Your grace in my own soul and in others than me, O You Who guarded from what terrifies.
Bless with a blessing that honours my side, with a peace that honours my life,
upon him for whom my being is known, and teaching has yielded to me in love of him.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And preserve by his mighty standing my life from what does not please You, O You Who lengthen my life.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have released me, You have made room for me: so accept my gratitude from me, O Granter of remembrance.
Bless with a blessing and a peace without end, neither for it nor for it, upon him with whom has ended
my journey to You, and he is Aḥmad, O You toward Whom I have turned, O Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
I have venerated Your noble Countenance forever by abandoning my relapse (into sin): so make my gladness perpetual.
You have preserved my life from harm and turbidity, O You Who make the decree flow with glad tidings for me.
Bless with a blessing and a peace that bear witness for me to my being truthful and make me happy,
upon him who made me inherit the benefits, by leave of an Everlasting One Who never ceases to benefit.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my writing through him, Lord, with You the greatest good pleasure, and with Your host.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have unveiled for me an unveiling that shows me what was hidden, and protected me from enemies and accusations.
Bless with a blessing that unveils the secrets for me toward the Gardens, that bars the wicked
from turning toward me with a refuge (against me), with a peace that bestows favours on me,
upon him by whose mighty standing You came between — O Best of Him with Whom one converses intimately with ordered pearls —
between me and whoever contends, O Subduer (Al-Qāhir) Who has no contender.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And accept from me, my King, my letters, leading to piety and recognised good.
And efface the turning of idle talk and breach toward my life, O You Who decree for my gladness.
And make Satan despair of turning toward me forever, O You toward Whom is my turning.
And bar Your enemies from wanting a refuge that grieves me, O You Who protected me with favours.
And make my letters abiding rewards, without end, ascending to the Gardens.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Toward others than me You have already taken away the Accursed, without returning him to me, O Helper,
removing toward a direction other than mine all that grieves or harms, wherever it is known.
Bless with a blessing and a peace that rise to the Throne and the Footstool, that at once give pleasure,
upon him for whom are my pens and the ink, over a span of years, with a writing possessed of soundness,
as worship for You and service for him, for the Countenance of Him Who preferred him over creation.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward him on my behalf with clear goods, O You Who through him perpetuated well-being for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have protected me from enemies and sickness, and You make good pleasure eternal for me in my aim.
And You have been for me with what perpetuates my gladness, glad tidings for angel and man.
Bless with a blessing and a peace that endure as eternally as Your dominion and make all of me happy,
upon the Prophet Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Generous (Al-Karīm) and Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz),
bless with a blessing and a peace by which You honour my side forever, and it is honoured,
upon him by whose standing I have hoped for good from You, and that You withhold harm
toward others than me, forever, through him, just as You made him an arbiter, entrusted with judgement.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me keenness and sainthood, and soften for me, and make gentle for me every sign.
And guard Your Book with my heart and my hand, and beautify me, and bestow the excellent on me.
You have guided all of me with Your enabling grace, O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), O All-Aware (Al-Khabīr): my doubt has vanished.
Grant me Your remembrance, bestow love on me and protect me with the best knowledge and soundness.
Renew Islām through me; draw for me the beneficial sciences, O All-Aware, O All-Knowing.
You have granted me the undertaking, Lord of the Hour, O You Who spared me the turbidities of the hour.
